sections.text: NIOS Hall Ticket 2026 Released for October Exams — Download Class 10th & 12th Theory & Practical Admit Card

sections.html: Direct Link for NIOS Hall Ticket Class 10thDirect Link for NIOS Hall Ticket Class 12th

NIOS Hall Ticket 2026 for the October–November public examination has been released. Both the theory hall ticket and the practical hall ticket for Class 10th (Secondary) and Class 12th (Senior Secondary) are now live on the official NIOS Student Portal. Students can download their admit card immediately using their 12-digit enrollment number — no login password is required.

sections.text: NIOS Theory & Practical Hall Ticket 2026 — Available Now

sections.html: NIOS has activated the hall ticket download facility for the October–November 2026 session. On the student portal you will find a Hall Ticket Type dropdown with two separate options — Hall Ticket for Theory Examination and Hall Ticket for Practical Examination. These are two different documents, so you must download and print both.

Your practical exams are held at your allotted study centre and your theory exams at your allotted examination centre, and the centre details printed on each hall ticket may be different. Check both carefully as soon as you download them.

sections.text: What to Do Right After Downloading Your Hall Ticket

sections.html:
• Download both hall tickets — theory and practical — and print at least two copies of each.
  • Check your name, enrollment number, photograph, subject list and exam centre address on both documents.
  • Match your subject-wise exam dates with the NIOS Date Sheet 2026 so that no paper is missed.
  • Note the reporting time and centre address, and visit the centre location a day in advance if it is unfamiliar.
  • Keep your practical files, lab records and a valid photo ID ready along with the printed hall ticket.
  • If you spot any error, or your hall ticket is not generating, call SS Coaching at 09839065533 immediately — corrections take time, so do not wait until the exam day.

sections.text: NIOS Hall Ticket 2026 Is Mandatory at the Exam Centre

sections.html: NIOS Hall Ticket 2026 is compulsory for every student appearing in the October–November 2026 examinations. Candidates must carry a printed copy of the hall ticket to the examination centre on every exam day, along with a valid photo ID, for verification by the invigilator. Entry is not permitted without it, and a copy on your phone is not accepted in place of a printout.

sections.text: NIOS Hall Ticket 2026 Details at a Glance
How to Download NIOS Hall Ticket 2026 for Class 10th & 12th

sections.html: Downloading your NIOS hall ticket, whether for theory or practical exams, takes only a few steps:

• Visit the official NIOS Student Portal at sdmis.nios.ac.in.
  • Enter your enrollment number — the 12-digit number provided to you at the time of NIOS admission.
  • Click on the "Hall Ticket Type" dropdown and select either Theory or Practical, depending on which exam you are downloading it for.
  • Click Submit — your hall ticket will open on the screen with your photo, exam centre, and subject-wise schedule.
  • Repeat the same steps with the other Hall Ticket Type so that you have both the theory and the practical admit card.
  • Download and print at least two copies — one to carry to every exam and one to keep safe until your results are declared.

Hall Ticket Not Generating? This almost always means one of two things — your examination fee for the October–November 2026 session is unpaid or incomplete, or your photograph is missing from NIOS records. Both have to be sorted out through your Regional Centre or study centre, and neither can be fixed on the exam day, so check now rather than later.

Important Note for Students: Preserve a printed copy of your NIOS Hall Ticket from the day it is downloaded until your results are declared — you may need it for verification even after your exams are over. Carry the original printed hall ticket to the examination hall every day; entry without it is not permitted.

If you are unable to download your NIOS Hall Ticket 2026, or if you notice any error in your name, subjects, or exam centre, contact SS Coaching at 09839065533 for immediate assistance. We will guide you through the entire process of downloading your NIOS admit card for the October–November 2026 exams.
